introHtml: Paper lunch bags, boxes, and totes offer a sustainable alternative for businesses looking to reduce plastic use. Unlike vinyl or nylon options, paper is compostable and recyclable, making it ideal for eco-conscious brands. The Kraft Paper Insulated Retro Luncher provides excellent insulation while maintaining a natural look, and the Textured Embossed Eurototes add a premium feel. Custom printing with your logo is straightforward on paper surfaces, ensuring your brand stands out at corporate picnics or employee events.
